summary.lv: Atea Global Services meklē Onboarding Project Delivery Lead, kurš/-a vadīs jaunu klientu IT produktu un pakalpojumu ieviesanas projektus globālā vidē, vadīs komandu un nodrošinās augstu klientu apmierinātību, balstoties uz ITIL labākajām praksēm.
summary.en: Atea Global Services is seeking an Onboarding Project Delivery Lead to manage IT product and service onboarding projects for new customers globally, lead a team, and ensure smooth handover to operations following ITIL best practices in a multi-country environment.
